title: Deny STEP review to same-project peers and revoked owners
description:
## Context
OVD-520's testing requirement includes tenant-denial regressions. The OVD-563 contract (docs/release/ovd-563-step-review-contract.md:28-33) requires the same owner and the active operator/project access gate, and says 'revoked access returns no data'.

The staged proof tests only the owner and a cross-org actor (ovd-563-step-review-proof.sql:47-60). Actor n(2) fails both the owner check and the access check, so removing either check would go undetected.

n(3) is an org A client, a project editor and an enabled operator (supabase/tests/engineering_native_ownership.sql:14-24), so only the owner clauses deny it (ovd-563-step-review-forward.sql:171-172). A revoked n(1) passes the owner clauses, so only `engineering_access` denies it (:175).

Every denial raises 42501, including `ovd563_review_integrity_failure` (:206). With the owner clauses removed, n(3) would fail at :197 with that message, which is why the expected messages must be pinned.

## Scope
Insert 4 assertions between proof lines 85 and 86, before the deliberate corruption at :87:
- a positive control that n(3) holds engineering access;
- a peer denial that pins `ovd563_review_unavailable`;
- a revoked-owner denial that pins `ovd563_review_unavailable`;
- an owner 'ready' control after access is restored.

Change the runner pin at scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs:735-736 from 21 to 25. The contract text already states the rule, so no doc change is needed.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `node scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs --reviewed-authority-baseline --durable-migration --ovd563` exits 0 with OVD-563 25/25, locally and in the hosted 'Disposable staged SQL proof' check at the PR head.
- [ ] Mutation 1: deleting the owner clauses (forward :171-172) in a scratch copy makes the peer denial 'not ok'.
- [ ] Mutation 2: deleting the `engineering_access` clause (:175) makes the revoked-owner denial 'not ok'.
- [ ] engineering_operators.enabled is restored inside the same rolled-back transaction before the existing corruption tests.
- [ ] If either denial fails on unmodified staged SQL, stop and open a separate security-reviewed issue. Do not patch the forward SQL here.

## Verification commands
```bash
flock /tmp/ovd-replay.lock node scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs --reviewed-authority-baseline --durable-migration --ovd563
git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/handoff/jarvis-reviewed-e5e3db0
flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify
```

## Out of scope
- Any change to ovd-563 forward or reverse SQL.
- UI changes.
- 558/560/561 files (#565 pins their SHA-256).

Parent: OVD-520
failure_first:
The new assertions pin existing behaviour, so failure-first is by mutation, on scratch copies of docs/release/ovd-563-step-review-forward.sql in a scratch worktree only. Each mutation run takes about 2 minutes under the replay lock.
- Mutation 1: delete `or c.owner_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or t.owner_user_id is distinct from auth.uid()` (lines 171-172). The peer throws_ok must report 'not ok': it now raises ovd563_review_integrity_failure, which proves the pinned message matters.
- Mutation 2: delete `or not engineering_private.engineering_access(c.organization_id,c.project_id)` (line 175). The revoked-owner throws_ok must report 'not ok', because it now returns 'ready'.

Record both failing runs (output IDs and error strings). Never commit mutated SQL.
verification:
In this container:
- `flock /tmp/ovd-replay.lock node scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs --reviewed-authority-baseline --durable-migration --ovd563` exits 0. Check ovd563-step-review-proof.json assertions 25 and ovd563-behavior.txt with no 'not ok'.
- The two mutation runs fail as described.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/handoff/jarvis-reviewed-e5e3db0` exits 0. Against `origin/codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003` a conflict is expected; document the port.
- `flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify`.

HOSTED-CI: the 'Disposable staged SQL proof' check (from C1) must be green at the PR head, showing 25/25.
